title: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister's Public Health Insurance – CMCHIS hospitalization pathway Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Publicly funded hospitalization protection under Tamil Nadu's comprehensive health insurance framework.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility follows current CMCHIS residence, household and beneficiary criteria.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Tamil Nadu Chief Minister's Public Health Insurance – CMCHIS hospitalization pathway.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
